qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unmatched route density across ~11,000 routes serving over 1 million business customer locations creates an insurmountable per-stop cost advantage over regional peers. Multi-year service agreements with automatic price escalation clauses and customized garment branding/RFID tracking generate substantial customer switching friction. Moat proven by 27% 5-year median GAAP ROIC, ~78% operating tangible ROIC, and steady gross margin expansion past 50%. Primary erosion risks include sharp cyclical employment drawdowns reducing client headcount and potential antitrust headwinds on large-scale M&A.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Dominant North American uniform and facility services route monopoly with unmatched route density, pricing power, and elite owner-operator execution. Insulated from AI disruption and a direct beneficiary of North American industrial reshoring. Fortress balance sheet with net debt payable in <0.8 years of net income and interest coverage >24x. [5-10Y g: new business volume 3.5% + contract price escalation 2.0% + cross-selling facility/safety services 2.5% - margin drags 0.0% + net share buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC expanded from 13.5% in FY2016 to 31.7% in FY2025 (median 27.0%); operating tangible ROIC exceeds 75%. Continuous peak-to-peak EPS compounding through COVID disruptions (Owner EPS compounded from $1.12 in FY2016 to $5.21 in FY2025 at ~16% CAGR). FCF conversion averages ~91% ($1.75B+ Owner FCF in FY2025). Total long-term debt of $1.43B easily covered by $2.0B net income (0.71x net income); EBIT/interest coverage of 24.5x. Proven pricing power with gross margin expanding from ~44% to >50%.
